publications.title: Computer Vision for Automated Damage Detection in Offshore Wind Turbine Inspection
publications.summary: Developed a YOLOv8-based offshore turbine damage detection system with 96.5% F1 on severe defects, projected to save $3.4M over 25 years for a 100-turbine wind farm.

publications.title: Online Budget-Aware Ad Allocation with Dynamic Throttling and Dual-Pricing Policies
publications.summary: Developed adaptive budget-aware algorithms for online ad allocation, narrowing the optimality gap to 4.5% on a 100k-impression dataset.

publications.title: Sparse Optimization for LLM Compression under Data Scarcity: Evidence from DistilGPT-2
publications.summary: Applied L1 (lasso) and group lasso methods to prune DistilGPT2 (82M parameters) using the WikiText-2 dataset, reducing parameter count while maintaining perplexity.

publications.title: Detecting AI-Generated Art through Generative Artifacts: A CNN–ResNet50 Comparison
publications.summary: Built and benchmarked real-vs-AI artwork classifiers using custom CNNs and pretrained vision models (CNNs, ResNet) on a 21k-image dataset, achieving high-accuracy discrimination for art-fraud detection.

publications.title: Kaetram Arena
publications.summary: Teaches a small open model (Qwen 2B) to play a persistent open-world MMORPG through long-horizon, tool-mediated actions, with teacher and student sharing one typed 17-tool API. Copying a stronger cross-family teacher made the student worse; on-policy distillation from a same-family teacher lifted it from 12 to 18 out of 30 on a long-horizon quest benchmark.

publications.title: Subliminal Learning
publications.summary: A replication and extension of Anthropic's subliminal-learning result across both image and language models; it traces the effect to the two models starting from the same initialization rather than to the training data, and reconciles two published numbers that had disagreed.

publications.title: Crucible
publications.summary: A small team of cooperating agents (a researcher, a reviser, and an LLM judge) that grades how faithfully an AI's answers stay grounded in their sources and how much of the relevant material it retrieves, with per-call cost and latency tracing; built on Google's ADK and runs fully offline.

publications.title: Clinical Corpus Pipeline
publications.summary: Turns synthetic medical records and claims into training examples where every clinical statement traces back to the exact source it came from, gated by automated privacy and grounding checks; dependency-free, 54 tests.

publications.title: Attractor Lens
publications.summary: A tool for studying what happens when a language model is left talking to itself: it detects when the conversation converges into a repeating pattern using embedding similarity rather than the eye, and tests whether the opening prompt predicts where it lands; runs fully local.

publications.title: Deterministic Voice Intelligence
publications.summary: A finance voice assistant built around one rule: speech recognition and the LLM only turn what you say into structured commands, while plain deterministic code makes every real decision and calculation, so the model can't invent a transaction; 85+ tests.

publications.title: ScreenMem
publications.summary: Gives your Mac a searchable memory of what has been on screen: it captures and reads the screen locally, then lets you search by keyword or meaning and ask questions, with every answer linked back to the moment it appeared; nothing leaves your machine.

publications.title: Spark Studio
publications.summary: An AI coding playground for kids: describe a game and it builds a playable version, then shows the real code behind it and lets them ask questions and remix each other's work; 3rd place at the Claude Builders @ MIT hackathon.

publications.title: Project SERVE
publications.summary: A full member portal for a school volleyball club, with sign-in, analytics, and event registration, built end to end with Flask, Streamlit, and SQLite; an earlier team project.
